question: Does the false permission for pair574 depend on coordinates lying in other annotated instance boxes at either endpoint?
hypothesis: Overlapping/occluding instances may contaminate paired support. Rectangles only proxy ambiguity and do not establish visible pixel ownership.

ranked_alternatives.cause: Other annotated instances intersect paired support
ranked_alternatives.basis: annotation geometry motivates a directly testable proxy; physical ownership unproved

intervention_location: Saved feature patches immediately before frozen channel statistics/readout. No recurrent state, core, weights, or production mutation.
query: Each representation original archived winning query, fixed; no shift reselection.

masks.identity: Clone full support; exact equal score
masks.dual_gt: reference center inside its own GT box AND current query center inside candidate GT box
masks.dual_exclusive: dual_gt AND neither endpoint center inside ANY other annotated instance box (all categories, with box2d; exclude own endpoint ID only)

label_route: Raw video frame -> saved runtime_inputs anchors[frame] -> frameIndex and matching name -> GT labels; never direct raw frameIndex lookup.
support_gate: At least3 paired cells and at least1 nonconstant channel at both endpoints; otherwise unknown, never success.
controls: For each dual_gt and dual_exclusive mask: matched k-point cyclic subsets at every start and199 fixed-seed random subsets without replacement, from full parent for dual_gt and dual_gt parent for dual_exclusive. Seed57420261112 + case_index*100 + representation_index. Same subsets for both heads.
acceptance: Original full frozen scores reproduced within1e-9 for all30 outcomes before interpretation; identity exactly equal.
Independent audit reconstructs masks from annotations and scalar point-in-box checks, recomputes every saved score via independent implementation within1e-9; source/input hashes unchanged.

Support association evidence only if574 native C34 score crosses from >0 to <=0 under exclusive mask, sufficient support, and intervention score is below95% of same-count random controls. Report all representations/heads/cases and exact ranks; no multiple-case population inference.
A physical-source claim additionally requires independent actual visible-part evidence. Rectangle exclusion alone cannot close it; no closure if insufficient support.
Compare own232/70/1102/832 changes and missing support; no claim of useful fix if own decisions fail.
qualitative: Create native-pixel nearest-neighbor zoom overlays at both574 endpoints with all nearby annotated boxes, IDs and paired centers. Report occlusion and available label geometry. Do not infer pixel ownership from rectangle overlap.
followup: If exclusive mask cannot establish physical source, report why and propose one separately registered bounded distinguishing test using independent visible-part labels or causal source-pixel intervention; do not run unregistered new outcomes.
limits: Five selected archived cases, not an untouched evaluation set
GT support is diagnostic oracle information, never a deployable intervention
Center exclusivity does not isolate retinal13x13 pooling, interpolation triangles or neural receptive fields
Cannot claim a unique root cause, identity quality, actual ID switch, HOTA or full-tracker improvement
